title: Fixed Window Riser Split Limb and Eccentric Wheel Bow
description: One newly authored complete compound-bow-inspired sports display exterior, laid flat in one fixed illustrative pose without arrows. A thick centre grip joins complete upper and lower open-window riser members and two fixed root pockets. Four separate full short curved limbs form two bifurcated ends around two independent thick eccentric-wheel appearances, each with a genuine off-centre axle bore, complete transverse pin and retainers. One full front string and two independent crossing display cables occupy separated depth layers. This is not the old single continuous double-recurve bow with two decorative discs added: the rigid pierced riser, rooted split-limb structure and separate axle-carried end-wheel organization are all newly constructed. No prior visible mesh imported or extracted. Unlike the small four-lobe climbing device, there is no stacked plate head, long loop handle or trigger crossbar. Four opaque PBR roles, metre game-space coordinates, Z up and horizontally centred whole envelope. One static prop zero scenes. Pure stylized visual artwork only: decorative wheel curves and cable routing are not a functional design; no draw path, stored energy, force, release, string tension, projectile, ballistic effect, manufacture, sport suitability or safe handling represented. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
